text:
Sofia: Quick heads-up — planning to cut the release branch for v1.14 TOMORROW at 15:00 UTC. Need final signoffs on the version bump, changelog note, and any mandatory backports. Please paste PR numbers you want carried over.

Release Bot: Heads-up: release branch cut window opens 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z. Freeze non-critical merges 1 hour prior. Full checklist: https://redwood.internal/releases.

Mike: Who's creating `release/v1.14`? I can if no one else has plans.

Sofia: Sam usually does the cut. @Sam can you take the branch creation, unless you want me to? We just need coordinated cherry-picks afterwards.

Sam: I can create the branch at the cutoff. Plan: create `release/v1.14` from `main` at 15:00 UTC, push, open a tracking PR titled `release: track v1.14 branch` and tag owners. If anyone needs the branch earlier to run final checks, say now.

Priya: Quick policy Q: test-only or infra CI fixes (example: #5123, flaky CI suppression) — do we backport those to the release branch or keep them on main and patch post-cut? It's currently causing RC flakes.

Sofia: Rule of thumb: backport test/CI fixes that block release validation. Docs-only or cosmetic changes can wait. If the RC pipeline is flaky because of it, include on the branch.

Mike: Adding my PRs here:
- #6001 — bump to 1.14.0 + changelog stub
- #6022 — kv-cache edge-case fix (regression)

Mike: Request backport for #6022. #6001 I'll apply on the branch after creation to avoid main/tag drift.

Priya: I'll open a backport PR for #5123 and tag it `release:backport-request`. It's small, should be safe to cherry-pick.

Sam: Please label backports with `release:backport-request` (or `release-backport`) and put links here. I'll pick them up after I create the branch. If any cherry-pick conflicts, comment in the PR and tag @Sam for manual resolve.

Sofia: Changelog process reminder: append bullets under Unreleased in `CHANGELOG.md`, then open one consolidated PR titled `changelog: v1.14 notes` and add the `release-note` label. We prefer a single changelog PR to minimize merge collisions on the branch.

Mike: I'll open the changelog PR now and add the label. I won't bump the version on main; will do the version bump on the release branch once it's created.

Priya: Merge style question: do we want `git cherry-pick -x` for traceability and then normal PR merges into `release/v1.14`? Or do fast-forward merges?

Sam: Prefer `git cherry-pick -x` so the original PR shows in history. For the initial cut I'll create the branch with `--no-ff` to mark the cut cleanly. Afterwards normal PR merges to the release branch are fine.

Release Bot: Pre-cut checklist:
```
- ✅ run unit + integration CI on main
- ✅ smoke e2e on canary
- ⏲️ freeze non-critical merges 1h before cut
- ⚠️ 15:00 UTC: create `release/v1.14` from `main`
- 📌 open tracking PR and tag release owners
```

Sofia: Action items:
- Mike: open changelog PR & add `release-note` (in flight)
- Priya: open backport PR for #5123 and add `release:backport-request` label
- Sam: create `release/v1.14` at 15:00 UTC and post tracking PR

Mike: ack :thumbsup:
Priya: on it :ok_hand:
Sam: will do — ping me if you see conflicts after the cut

Sofia: If anything changes, post updates here. Otherwise we plan to cut at 15:00 UTC tomorrow. :rocket:
